items.note: below. The pass and the follower now share one test, `reroutedBy`. It follows a derived end's `dependsOn` to the nodes that move; the pass used to count every derived end as moved.

A collinear vertex in a route suppresses crossings within `r` of it
items.note: `edgeHops` and `withHops` both work on the route with straight-through vertices dropped.
